login.resetSuccess: Password updated. Log in with your new password.

register.error: Something went wrong. Please check your details and try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link. Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.error: Couldn't send the link. Please try again.
forgot.tooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.error: Couldn't update your password. Please try again.

changePassword.title: Password
changePassword.hint: We'll email a link to your email. Open it to set your new password.
changePassword.sent: Link sent to {email}. Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires in 30 minutes.
changePassword.tooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
changePassword.error: Couldn't send the link. Please try again.

qr.scanHint: Point the camera at the login QR you saved from your Profile.
qr.notLoginQr: That QR code isn't a SnapStock login QR.

qr.noCamera: Can't open the camera. Allow camera access, or upload a picture of your QR instead.
qr.noQrInImage: No QR code found in that image.
qr.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
qr.error: Couldn't log in. Please try again.

qr.revokeConfirm: Revoke your login QR? It will stop working right away.

qr.createError: Couldn't create the QR. Please try again.

payouts.qrAdd: Tap to add your QR code
payouts.saveError: Could not save the payout account. Please try again.

dateRange.invalid: Pick a start date on or before the end date.

checkout.discountTooBig: The discount is more than the subtotal.

inventory.costHint: What one unit costs you. Used for profit and margin in Analytics.

reject.title: Reject this order?
reject.body: The buyer's {amount} order is cancelled and its items go back into stock.

void.title: Void this sale?
void.body: Use this for a sale entered by mistake. The {amount} sale is removed from your reports and its items go back into stock.
void.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. wrong item, rang up twice

delete.label: Delete transaction
delete.title: Delete this transaction?
delete.body: The {amount} sale is voided: it's removed from your reports and its items go back into stock. It stays in your list marked Voided.

refund.title: Refund this sale?
refund.body: Use this when the buyer returns the items. {amount} is recorded as a refund and the items go back into stock.

orders.nudgeOne: 1 order is waiting for payment confirmation
orders.nudgeMany: {count} orders are waiting for payment confirmation
orders.noProof: No payment screenshot yet — you can confirm once the buyer uploads one.
orders.sellerCashHint: Cash order — confirm once the buyer pays you.
orders.payTo: Pay the seller using one of these
orders.noPayoutAccounts: This seller hasn't added payment accounts yet — message them for payment details.
orders.proofSent: Screenshot sent — waiting for the seller to confirm.
orders.buyerCashHint: Pay the seller at pickup — they'll confirm your order.
orders.cancelConfirm: Tap again to cancel this order
orders.buyerAccountHint: Online orders from buyers waiting for your approval — check the payment, then approve or reject.

analytics.noSalesInRange: No sales in this range yet.
analytics.partialCost: Only {pct} of these sales have a cost price, so profit covers those sales only.
analytics.noCost: Add cost prices to your products to see profit and margin.
analytics.breakdownHint: Gross sales at your list prices, minus price changes, discounts and refunds. Voided sales are left out.

statusHint.stockout_risk: At the current pace these run out within 7 days.

statusHint.overstocked: More than 60 days of stock at the current pace.
statusHint.healthy: Stock and sales are in balance.

analytics.forecastMethod: Based on the last 7 and 30 days of sales. An estimate, not a guarantee.
analytics.forecastMethodWeekday: Based on the last 7 and 30 days of sales, adjusted for your busy and quiet weekdays. An estimate, not a guarantee.
